newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds end mixed after slow session.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds end mixed after slow session.

text.p: Argentine bonds finished mixed Friday after an unevenftul session with Brady issues slightly higher and local issues lower.
"There was very little action," said a trader at a local bank. "But the market remains strong."
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/8 at 95-1/4 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was down $0.60 at 119.05.
Traders said the market was set to retain its overall strong tone next week, although many were hoping there would be a bout of profit-taking before it resumes its upward push.
"Hopefully there will be some small shake out before the market rises again," said another trader.
No domestic market-moving news is anticipated in coming sessions, leaving the market to take its cue from U.S. Treasuries.
Several U.S. economic indicator releases next week, including jobless figures, were seen as the main market focus.
